blocks.text: Furinno Luder 5-Tier open shelf features simplicity and easy blend in with any home decor. It offers multiple colors to create your own storage space that can pair well with most aesthetics. This bookcase offers versatility to create vertical or horizontal storage. This series is made of CARB Grade composite wood. The clean-lined shelves provide ample space for your belongings, books, magazines, family photos, potted plants, treasured trinkets, and more. There is no foul smell, durable and the material is stable. A simple attitude towards lifestyle is reflected directly on the design of Furinno Furniture, creating a trend of simply nature. Care instructions: wipe clean with clean damped cloth. Avoid using harsh chemicals. Pictures are for illustration purpose. All decor items are not included in this offer.

items.label: SLEEK & VERSATILE DESIGN
items.value: This book shelf showcases a tall 5-tier layout with a closed back that fits seamlessly in living rooms, bedrooms, home offices, or dorms, making the book shelf practical and modern

items.label: 5-TIER STORAGE SPACE
items.value: This bookshelf provides multiple wide shelves to organize books, decor, framed photos, or storage bins, helping the book shelf keep your area neat and functional

items.label: WEIGHT CAPACITY
items.value: Each cube supports up to 30 lb (13.6 kg); 150 lb (68 kg) total when evenly distributed; keeping the bookshelf safe and reliable for daily storage

items.label: STURDY BUILT
items.value: Crafted from high-quality, durable composite wood, featured back panel adds extra stability and prevents items from falling behind. Built with FSC-certified wood, it unites sustainable materials and refined craftsmanship to deliver long-term durability and reliable use
